recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-41267 clarification in the active Dosage source without expanding into the separate, not-yet-Applied FHIR-51540 redesign.
issue_request: FHIR-41267 was an Applied Pharmacy change request for FHIR-core Dosage. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution said to replace the confusing second sentence of the Dosage.asNeededFor comment with an invariant-based note, and to add the false/not-PRN schedule sentence as a comment on Dosage.asNeeded.
initial_application: The original Jira-tagged source commit 9ca299e085 changed source/datatypes/dosage.xml but only edited Dosage.asNeededFor. It put both the invariant note and the asNeeded=false sentence on Dosage.asNeededFor, so Dosage.asNeeded still lacked the sentence explicitly assigned to it by the resolution.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Dosage as an active datatype, routes it through the dosage page, and marks it normative, confirming source/datatypes/dosage.xml is current build input. The invariant constraining Dosage.asNeededFor when Dosage.asNeeded is false remains present. Focused Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion; PHAR minutes corroborate the 7-0-0 approval. FHIR-51540 later touched the broader Dosage spreadsheet but remains Resolved - change required and does not reverse this Applied clarification.
reconciliation: Edited source/datatypes/dosage.xml so Dosage.asNeeded now carries the asNeeded=false schedule/not-PRN sentence, while Dosage.asNeededFor keeps only the reason sentence plus the invariant-based note.
source_changes: source/datatypes/dosage.xml: moved the asNeeded=false schedule/not-PRN clarification from Dosage.asNeededFor to Dosage.asNeeded, retaining the invariant-based Dosage.asNeededFor guidance.
